context_policy.policy: Analytic continuation, immutable centre128 RGB/CFA/sigma, independent halo noise. Score same32pixel centre as before; no reflection/resizing.

plan.conditioning: Two-level equivariant noise U-Net width8/16/32, forty input features including quadratic standardized residual; zero head, bound3sigma, frozen reconstruction. Expanded context, same scored centre.

policy.distribution: Log-uniform frequency/amplitude; uniform direction/phase/DC; two plane waves.

clean_fixed_point.scope: Every positive-noise training exposure; clean CFA with the same observed-sigma field.
clean_fixed_point.target: Zero CFA correction on clean signal, no RGB interpolation compensation.
clean_fixed_point.normalization: Same noisy RGB reference energy and tempered floor as the data term.

plan.noise_gate_policy: Each positive level: RGB MSE full/parent<=.98, opponent full/parent<=1, full/without_correction RGB<=1; weak/edge gradient>=.95 parent. Zero noise retains original12gates, new mixed and historical20/80.
plan.training_policy: Final512-stage checkpoint only after2048inherited steps; both seeds and arms fixed before outcomes. Fresh Adam0.00025, same replay and gradient cap1; no score selection.

checkpoint_policy.boundary: After completed Adam step only; restart partial microbatch from last committed checkpoint.
checkpoint_policy.selection: One atomic latest checkpoint, no validation scores or best-checkpoint selection.
checkpoint_policy.state: CPU model, Adam, completed step, losses, exposure counts, torch CPU RNG; data/noise draws derive deterministically from step.

limits: Independent Gaussian CFA noise with variance a*max(clean signal,0)+b, before demosaicing; not a sensor calibration.
Sigma estimated from observed signal and known simulation coefficients, not from clean truth.
Noisy bilinear reference in tempered loss; its energy includes noise as well as content.
Three-sigma bounded front correction; joint fine tuning can alter the trunk, cfa_front freezes it and skips gradient-free zero-noise anchors.
Frozen parent has fewer training steps; disabling correction in the trained model isolates the front-end contribution but is not an independently optimized witness.
Same procedural families and fixed4phase generator, not photographic validation.

structure_preservation.policy: Continuous convex mixture between single-projection and averaged dual-projection losses; one current implementation.

warm_start.optimizer: Fresh Adam in both arms; moments not inherited.

continuation.data: Exact first512 original exposures, phases and noise draws replayed in both arms.
